title: joined
description: S→C. The parameters the client is to run on. Carries the COURSE, not a reference to it — or, joining a public race whose course is not yet published, `waiting` instead: where the start is, until a `course` message hands the geometry over. `fixSeconds` is ABSENT when there is no race behind the join, which is how the boat is told to report no fixes (§8.2).
